title_en: Notice of the Supreme People's Court on Issuing the Several Opinions on Providing Judicial Guarantees for Improving the Business Environment
full_text_en:
Supreme People's Court

Notice on Issuing the Several Opinions on Providing Judicial Guarantees for Improving the Business Environment

Fa Fa [2017] No. 23

To: Higher People's Courts of all provinces, autonomous regions, and municipalities directly under the Central Government; the Military Court of the People's Liberation Army; the Production and Construction Corps Branch of the Higher People's Court of the Xinjiang Uygur Autonomous Region

The Several Opinions of the Supreme People's Court on Providing Judicial Guarantees for Improving the Business Environment are hereby issued to you for earnest implementation.

August 7, 2017

Several Opinions on Providing Judicial Guarantees for Improving the Business Environment

With the aim of improving the investment and market environment, creating a stable, fair, transparent, and predictable business environment, and providing stronger judicial services and guarantees for accelerating the establishment of a new system of an open economy, these Opinions are formulated in light of the actual work of the people's courts in adjudication and enforcement.

I. Legally and Equally Protect All Types of Market Entities, Promote the Improvement of the Legal System for Subjects of the Socialist Market Economy

1. Adhere to the principle of equal protection and fully safeguard the lawful rights and interests of all types of market entities. Fully implement the work requirements of equal protection for entities under different ownership systems, market entities from different regions, and stakeholders in different industries; adhere to the principles of equal legal status, equal protection of rights, and equal development opportunities for all market entities; legally resolve all types of conflicts and disputes; and promote the formation of an equal, orderly, and vibrant law-based business environment. Strictly implement the Opinion of the Supreme People's Court on Equally Protecting the Non-Public Sector of the Economy and Promoting its Healthy Development to provide a sound judicial environment for the healthy development of the non-public sector.

2. Further improve the system of legal person rules in accordance with the provisions of the legal person system under the General Provisions of the Civil Law of the People's Republic of China. In response to changes in the legal person system part of the General Provisions of the Civil Law of the People's Republic of China, promptly summarize issues arising during specific application, distinguish different situations for research and resolution, and promote the further improvement of the legal person system of the socialist market economy.

3. Strengthen the protection of minority shareholders and promote the improvement of corporate governance structures. Timely issue relevant judicial interpretations of the Company Law, properly handle cases involving disputes over the validity of corporate resolutions, shareholders' right to information, profit distribution rights, preemptive rights, and shareholder derivative actions, legally strengthen the protection of shareholders' rights, promote the standardization of corporate governance, enhance China's international image in protecting the rights and interests of minority shareholders, and increase social enthusiasm for investment.

II. Accurately Grasp Market Access Standards, Serve the Establishment of a New System of an Open Economy

4. Ensure proper alignment with commercial system reforms and promote a business environment more conducive to mass entrepreneurship and innovation. Properly address the impact of commercial registration system reform on judicial adjudication work, and effectively promote the resolution of legal application issues arising from the reform of the subscribed capital registration system. Utilize big data and modern information technology to actively promote the establishment of a unified national platform for the registration of property rights of all types and a platform for financial transaction registration, making market transactions more convenient and transparent.

5. Accurately grasp the negative list system for foreign investment and promote the effective utilization of foreign capital. When handling disputes involving foreign-invested enterprises, legally implement various measures of the foreign investment management system reform, accurately grasp the content of the negative list system for foreign investment and changes to the list, properly handle legal application issues concerning foreign investment access restrictions and share ratio restrictions arising from the gradual liberalization of foreign investment fields, and create a more open, fair, and convenient investment environment.

6. Lawfully adjudicate various types of foreign-related commercial and maritime cases, serve and guarantee the implementation of major national strategies such as the "Belt and Road Initiative." Fully leverage the adjudicative function, lawfully exercise judicial jurisdiction, adjudicate various types of foreign-related commercial and maritime cases fairly and efficiently, and equally protect the procedural rights and substantive rights and interests of Chinese and foreign parties. In accordance with the Several Opinions of the Supreme People's Court on Providing Judicial Services and Guarantees for the "Belt and Road Initiative" Construction, strengthen international judicial assistance with countries along the "Belt and Road," improve relevant working mechanisms, promptly resolve disputes, and create a sound legal environment for the "Belt and Road Initiative" construction.

7. Strengthen civil and commercial adjudication work related to Pilot Free Trade Zones, providing judicial guarantees for the construction of a new system of an open economy. Implement the Opinions of the Supreme People's Court on Providing Judicial Guarantees for the Construction of Pilot Free Trade Zones, actively cooperate with various reform measures in Pilot Free Trade Zones such as government function transformation, investment field opening, trade development mode transformation, and financial field opening and innovation, adjudicate various types of cases related to Pilot Free Trade Zones fairly and efficiently, and legally guarantee the institutional innovation in the construction of Pilot Free Trade Zones. For institutional deficiencies related to Pilot Free Trade Zone market rules discovered during case adjudication, promptly provide judicial suggestions to continuously promote the rule of law construction in Pilot Free Trade Zones.

8. Timely propose legislative or amendment suggestions and formulate or revise judicial interpretations to provide sound legal guarantees for foreign investment. Review judicial interpretations and policy documents concerning foreign investment; promptly revise or abolish those that are no longer consistent with the basic national policies and principles of opening up. For issues that need to be resolved through the formulation of relevant laws and regulations, promptly propose legislative or amendment suggestions; for issues that need to be resolved through the issuance of judicial interpretations, promptly issue judicial interpretations.

III. Ensure Fair and Just Market Transactions, Effectively Protect the Lawful Rights and Interests of Market Transaction Entities

9. Intensify the protection of property rights and consolidate the institutional foundation for a good business environment. Strictly implement the Opinions of the Central Committee of the Communist Party of China and the State Council on Improving the Property Rights Protection System and Legally Protecting Property Rights and the Opinions of the Supreme People's Court on Fully Leveraging the Adjudicative Function to Effectively Strengthen Judicial Protection of Property Rights, improve various market transaction rules, properly handle cases involving property rights protection, and promote the establishment and improvement of the legal system for property rights protection. Conduct in-depth research on and reasonably protect new types of rights, scientifically define the boundaries of property rights protection, properly mediate conflicts of rights, and effectively achieve the rule of law in property rights protection.

10. Lawfully adjudicate various contract cases, respect contractual freedom, and uphold contractual justice. Respect and protect the autonomy of will of market entities, reasonably judge the validity of contracts under various transaction models and innovative transaction structures, promote the decisive role of the market in resource allocation, and enhance the vitality of the market economy. Strictly in accordance with laws and judicial interpretations, determine the nature, validity, revocability, and dischargeability of contracts, and uphold contractual justice. Through adjudication of cases and timely issuance of guiding cases, announce to various market entities the proper rules for exercising rights and the legal consequences of violating obligations, and strengthen market entities' awareness of contracts, rules, and responsibilities. Properly handle issues where civil and administrative, or civil and criminal matters intersect, clarify the boundaries of legal application, establish corresponding mechanisms, and accurately grasp the standards of adjudication.

11. Properly adjudicate various financial cases, providing financial judicial support for optimizing the business environment. Lawfully adjudicate cases involving financial loans, guarantees, negotiable instruments, securities, futures, insurance, trusts, and private lending, protect lawful transactions, and balance the interests of all parties. Adhere to the principle of serving the real economy, guide and regulate various financial behaviors. Carefully review the transaction models and contract validity of various financial innovations, and accelerate research and issuance of corresponding judicial interpretations and judicial policies. Severely crack down on various financial crimes and illegal activities to maintain financial order. Strengthen the protection of financial consumers and effectively safeguard their lawful rights and interests. Enhance the professionalization of financial adjudication institutions and teams, and continuously improve the level of professionalism in financial adjudication.

12. Strictly and lawfully adjudicate various intellectual property cases, intensify intellectual property protection, and enhance the level of intellectual property protection. Strictly implement the Outline of Judicial Protection of Intellectual Property Rights in China (2016-2020), and continuously advance intellectual property adjudication. Strengthen research on legal issues concerning intellectual property protection in emerging fields and business forms, timely issue judicial interpretations and judicial policies, and promote the improvement of laws, regulations, and institutional systems for intellectual property protection. Strengthen the construction of the intellectual property court system, and fully leverage the institutional advantages of specialized adjudication bodies, full-time adjudicators, and professional adjudication work. Further leverage the judicial supervision function over intellectual property, increase the depth and breadth of judicial review of administrative acts concerning intellectual property authorization and confirmation, promote the improvement of mechanisms for reviewing the validity of rights in intellectual property litigation, reasonably strengthen the guiding role of civil litigation in resolving civil-administrative cross-cutting disputes in specific circumstances, and promote the substantive resolution of administrative disputes over intellectual property. Comprehensively use civil, administrative, and criminal means to severely punish various types of intellectual property infringement crimes and unlawful acts, and legally ensure that infringers bear corresponding costs.

13. Promote the establishment of a unified and open socialist market system, and foster orderly competition in the market. Strictly in accordance with relevant competition laws and regulations, regulate all types of monopolistic acts and unfair competition acts, properly handle cases that disrupt market competition rules, and fully leverage the role of judicial adjudication in maintaining and guiding a fair competition market environment. Further standardize administrative licensing and approval acts of administrative organs, and through methods such as establishing and improving a judicial jurisdiction system that is appropriately separated from administrative divisions, break departmental monopolies and local protection, promote the formation of a market supervision framework with clear powers and responsibilities, fairness and justice, transparency and efficiency, and legal guarantees, and provide judicial protection for maintaining a fair and orderly market competition environment.

14. Strengthen enforcement work, and fully guarantee the realization of the lawful rights and interests of the prevailing parties. Comprehensively build a working pattern for comprehensive governance of enforcement difficulty; in accordance with the requirements of the Work Outline on Implementing the Goal of Basically Resolving the Difficulty in Enforcement within Two to Three Years, improve the system of enforcement legal norms, strengthen enforcement informatization, increase enforcement efforts, standardize enforcement behavior, effectively enhance enforcement deterrence, and optimize enforcement results. Strictly in accordance with the provisions of the Criminal Law and judicial interpretations, legally pursue the criminal liability of judgment debtors, persons obligated to assist in enforcement, and sureties who refuse to enforce judgments or orders of the people's courts.

IV. Strengthen the Construction of Bankruptcy Systems and Mechanisms, Improve the Rescue and Exit Mechanisms for Subjects of the Socialist Market Economy

15. Improve the mechanism for initiating bankruptcy proceedings and the mechanism for identifying bankrupt enterprises, and effectively solve the difficulty in filing bankruptcy cases. In accordance with the relevant provisions of laws and judicial interpretations, promptly accept bankruptcy cases that meet the filing conditions, and shall not impose additional conditions beyond those provided by law. Fully promote the transfer of enforcement cases to bankruptcy review, achieving a sound working pattern of "enforce what can be enforced according to law, and bankrupt what overall enforcement cannot achieve and meets the statutory conditions for bankruptcy." Actively explore the diversion of bankruptcy cases based on complexity, promote the establishment of a simple and efficient fast-track trial mechanism, and attempt to include cases with clear facts, clear creditor-debtor relationships, or "no assets for bankruptcy" in the fast-track trial scope.

16. Promote the improvement of the bankruptcy reorganization and conciliation systems, and facilitate the regeneration of valuable but distressed enterprises. Guide all parties in bankruptcy proceedings to fully recognize the important role of reorganization and conciliation systems in rescuing distressed enterprises. Adhere to a market-oriented approach in carrying out bankruptcy reorganization work, place greater emphasis on business consolidation and asset restructuring, strictly apply the power of compulsory approval in accordance with the law, to achieve the core value and institutional goals of reorganization. Actively promote the establishment of an interconnecting mechanism between out-of-court mergers and restructuring and in-court bankruptcy proceedings, and strengthen exploration and research on the pre-packaged reorganization system. Study and formulate judicial interpretations on the bankruptcy reorganization system.

17. Severely crack down on various acts of "evasion of debts," and effectively safeguard the lawful rights and interests of market entities. Severely crack down on malicious acts of evading debts, legally apply means such as consolidated bankruptcy of affiliated enterprises in bankruptcy proceedings, exercise of avoidance powers and recovery rights, to locate and recover debtor property. Increase criminal penalties for crimes such as concealing or intentionally destroying accounting vouchers, accounting books, financial accounting reports, etc.

18. Coordinate and improve supporting systems for bankruptcy, and enhance the level of the rule of law in bankruptcy. Promote the establishment of a special fund for bankruptcy expenses to provide expense support for cases with "no assets for bankruptcy." Incorporate bankruptcy adjudication into the overall construction of the social credit system, and increase punishment efforts against dishonest entities. Promote the formulation of tax incentive laws and regulations for aspects such as debt exemption and property disposal of bankrupt enterprises, to effectively reduce the tax burden of bankrupt enterprises. Coordinate and resolve issues of credit repair for enterprises successfully reorganized or conciliated, to facilitate their return to the market. Promote the establishment of a unified coordination mechanism between the government and courts for bankruptcy work, and comprehensively coordinate business coordination, information provision, and stability maintenance in bankruptcy proceedings. Actively coordinate with the government to use financial reward and subsidy funds or establish special funds, to properly handle issues of employee placement and interest protection.

19. Strengthen the professionalization of bankruptcy adjudication organizations and bankruptcy administrator teams, and continuously improve the overall level of bankruptcy adjudication. Continuously promote the establishment and construction of bankruptcy adjudication divisions, and enhance the professional level of bankruptcy adjudication organizations and personnel. Research and formulate relevant judicial interpretations on bankruptcy administrators, and accelerate the professionalization of bankruptcy administrators. Effectively improve supporting mechanisms such as performance appraisal for bankruptcy adjudication, and increase the efficiency of bankruptcy adjudication work.

V. Promote the Construction of a Social Credit System, Provide Credit Guarantees for Continuously Optimizing the Business Environment

20. Fully utilize information technology to promote the continuous improvement of the social credit system. Explore the deep integration path between the construction of the social credit system and the adjudication and enforcement work of the people's courts, promote the establishment and improvement of mechanisms for the centralized collection, sharing, and use of judicial big data related to market entity credit information, and increase efforts in joint incentives for trustworthiness and joint punishment for dishonesty.

21. Severely punish acts of false litigation, and promote the construction of litigation integrity. Strictly in accordance with legal provisions, pursue the criminal liability of persons engaging in false litigation, obstruction of testimony, etc. Timely issue relevant judicial interpretations to clarify the standards for conviction and sentencing for the crime of false litigation. Improve regulatory mechanisms for dishonest litigation acts such as providing false evidence and intentionally delaying evidence submission, and severely sanction dishonest acts in litigation.

22. Intensify credit punishment against dishonest persons subject to enforcement, and promote the improvement of the dishonesty punishment mechanism. In accordance with the requirements of the Opinions on Accelerating the Construction of Mechanisms for Credit Supervision, Warning, and Punishment of Dishonest Persons Subject to Enforcement issued by the General Office of the Central Committee of the Communist Party of China and the General Office of the State Council, continuously improve institutional norms such as publishing the list of information on dishonest persons subject to enforcement and restricting their high consumption, and severely punish the dishonest acts of persons subject to enforcement. Promote the improvement of a comprehensive credit punishment pattern where dishonest entities "lose credit in one place and are restricted everywhere," promote the construction of social integrity, and achieve long-term governance.
